verdict.rationale: Grok Build has no documented native webhook subscription. Its hooks system does let users attach commands to agent lifecycle events, for example to 'send a notification when a turn ends' or log tool use, and it reads Claude Code and Cursor hook event files. A hook script could therefore forward events to an HTTP endpoint, but only as a user-built workaround. Missing for 10: native outbound webhook delivery to URLs, a documented event catalog/payload schema for webhook consumers, retry/signing semantics, and independent corroboration.
